recommendation: Keep the commit as-is. It completes the remaining QuestionnaireResponse-side part of FHIR-35941 without changing already-applied Questionnaire, Composition, or ObservationDefinition text; later spelling-only cleanup can remain separate.
issue_request: FHIR-35941 was Published with a Persuasive with Modification resolution for R5. It requested guidance explaining why to use Questionnaire versus QuestionnaireResponse and establishing boundaries with Composition; the resolution also called for guidance distinguishing Questionnaire from QuestionnaireResponse, Composition, StructureDefinition, and ObservationDefinition, plus QuestionnaireResponse guidance differentiating it from Composition and Observation.
initial_application: Commit e4f0d156d5ceafa1d371dc9a418885bbeb5b4add applied the Questionnaire-side guidance in source/questionnaire/questionnaire-introduction.xml. Current source already contained Questionnaire comparisons with QuestionnaireResponse, ObservationDefinition, Composition, and StructureDefinition, and the QuestionnaireResponse page already compared QuestionnaireResponse with Questionnaire and Observation, but it lacked the Composition comparison promised by the seed resolution.
additional_context: source/fhir.ini actively lists Questionnaire, QuestionnaireResponse, Composition, and ObservationDefinition, so the affected introduction files are in build scope. Follow-up issues FHIR-37924 and FHIR-37925 applied the ObservationDefinition-side and Composition-side guidance from the same issue family. FHIR SDC minutes for 2022-03-03 list FHIR-35941 as persuasive with modification. Searches found no conflicting Zulip discussion or later Jira decision for the QuestionnaireResponse/Composition boundary.
reconciliation: Added a narrow paragraph to source/questionnaireresponse/questionnaireresponse-introduction.xml explaining that QuestionnaireResponse and Composition can both organize content for human presentation, but Composition organizes existing resources in a document or attested collection while QuestionnaireResponse organizes answers to Questionnaire questions, with extraction to domain resources when the answers need document inclusion or discrete clinical use.
source_changes: source/questionnaireresponse/questionnaireresponse-introduction.xml: Added a Boundaries and Relationships paragraph distinguishing QuestionnaireResponse from Composition.
